description:
Manage Visual Spec baseline contracts for visual SDD (actions: set, verify, list). "set" registers a screenshot or design mockup as baseline; "verify" tests a live UI screenshot against a baseline; "list" returns all registered visual specs. Use manage_visual_spec instead of compare_states when verifying UI against approved design contracts rather than ad-hoc state comparisons.

Returns baseline registration confirmation, visual verification score, or registered spec list.

file_path.description: Absolute file path to image (for 'set' or 'verify')

sdd_requirement_id.description: Optional state-memory-mcp SDD requirement node ID for 'verify'

tolerance.description: dHash Hamming distance tolerance threshold for 'verify' (default: 8)

name: manage_visual_spec
